title: Facade Pattern
description: Provide a simplified interface to a complex subsystem.

data.text: The **Facade Pattern** provides a simplified interface to a complex subsystem. It doesn't hide the subsystem but provides a convenient entry point.

data.title: Facade Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Reduces coupling between client and subsystem
data.takeaway: Use Facade Pattern to provide a simple interface to a complex system.
